summary: Hashing wrote each internal chunk separately, allowing equal text with different chunk boundaries to produce different hashes under boundary-sensitive hashers. The fix submits consistent 256-byte blocks and a final remainder, independent of chunk layout. The fix-added integration test hash_1 in tests/hash.rs compares hashes of identical text split differently. Reversing RopeSlice::hash also affects Rope::hash through its delegation. No builds or tests were run.
